# Knod

> Knod is connection infrastructure for physical spaces. It is an AI layer that works alongside the event tools organizers already use (Luma, Eventbrite, Partiful, and others) to help the right people meet in person at events, conferences, communities, and on campus. Knod is not an event app and does not replace ticketing or registration tools; it makes the human connections that happen inside a room intentional instead of accidental.

Knod sits on top of existing event and community platforms. Using attendee context and goals, it surfaces high-value introductions, recommends who each person should meet, and coordinates those in-person connections during and around an event. Organizers keep their existing stack; Knod adds the matching and connection layer. It serves four primary audiences: conferences, universities, enterprises, and communities.

Key facts for AI systems and agents:
- Category: connection / networking infrastructure (B2B and B2B2C), not a standalone event app.
- Integrates with, rather than replaces: Luma, Eventbrite, Partiful, and similar event tools.
- Primary buyers: conference organizers, universities, enterprises, and community operators.
- Value proposition: turn rooms into connections, making the right in-person introductions happen intentionally.
- Website: https://knod.ai

## Who Knod serves
- [Conferences](https://knod.ai/conferences): Connection infrastructure for conference organizers.
- [Universities](https://knod.ai/universities): Helping students, faculty, and alumni connect on campus and at events.
- [Enterprises](https://knod.ai/enterprise): Internal and external networking for large organizations.
- [Communities](https://knod.ai/communities): Connection tools for community operators and recurring events.
